export_scope: Two byte-identical repeat Web exports from one clean guarded import. Browser validation is a separate required release gate.
scope: Tested illustrated main-menu and touch-navigation beta; not full-game acceptance.
features: Original illustrated castle-valley menu with Traditional Chinese serif title and responsive portrait/landscape composition. The illustration is menu artwork, not a gameplay screenshot.
Persistent large primary controls, explicit New Match confirmation/cancel and pause-preserving Resume.
Help supports ordinary single-finger scrolling; the final paragraph and Back remain reachable after resizing.
Existing contextual touch, visible compact Stop and terrain remain included; military/grip changes are not part of this menu release.

native_validation.scope: Headless controlled value, command and UI fixtures. Synthetic handlers and end states are not natural play, rendering, device or victory acceptance.

browser_validation.input: Chrome emulated touchscreen at320/390/844 profiles and desktop mouse/keyboard at1440; not physical phones

scenarios.passed: Home, real Help scrolling to fully visible final paragraph, Back, ordinary Start, owned worker selection, natural ticks, retained paused match, resize interruption, New Match Cancel, Resume and confirmed reset to observed owned-town-center startup state.

browser_validation.screenshots: Actual final-build menu, Help tail, pause, confirmation and rotated views inspected. Compact568x320 deliberately prioritizes artwork and full controls over repeated title/crest. Artwork is original illustration, not in-game rendering.
browser_validation.network_gate: Zero observed browser errors including context close. Exact pinned WASM/PCK GETs returned200 and finished.
browser_validation.fixture_cache_policy: Only two manifest-pinned public streams use no-cache in fresh isolated fixture contexts; other responses retain no-store. Public Pages uses its own caching policy. Earlier failed runs remain failed.

validation_limits: Physical iPhone/Android, audible audio, physical multi-touch ergonomics, OS background interruption and browser-history behavior remain unverified.
This release does not prove a complete rendered growth-to-victory match, current-build natural combat or terminal victory/defeat navigation.
Weapon/tool/shield grip corrections and expanded military progression are not included.
Browser tests used exact exported bytes on a hosted loopback server. Public served-byte verification follows deployment.
